text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Combining lisinopril (an ACE inhibitor) with spironolactone (a potassium-sparing diuretic) increases the risk of hyperkalemia [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. Drugs that inhibit the renin-angiotensin system, along with potassium-sparing diuretics, can cause elevated serum potassium levels [lisinopril:warnings_and_cautions:8, lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. Therefore, if concomitant use is indicated, the patient's serum potassium should be monitored frequently [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1].
